{{Top|leg}}
The '''Tetans''', also known as '''Korosians''', were the [[Human/Legends|Human]] inhabitants of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]]. Notable Tetans included [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Teta/Legends|Teta]], the [[Daragon family]], [[Aleema Keto]] and [[Satal Keto/Legends|Satal Keto]].
